text_block_list.text: My apologies, but may I step outside for some air? I need to feel the breeze.

text_block_list.text: My apologies, but may I step outside for some air? I need to feel the breeze.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It's all right, Trainer. I don't want to inconvenience you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Why is that? This loss was my fault and mine alone.
choice_data_list: It's a long journey to the top. Everyone needs a leg up now and then.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Point taken. I'll keep climbing, so would you lend me your strength, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder's hair ripples in the breeze as we discuss what led to today's defeat.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: …I would prefer to be somewhere else if possible. I know it's a selfish request.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: After all the times I've returned to this room following a loss… just the sight of it fills me with frustration.
choice_data_list: That's exactly why we should stay.
That's exactly why we should stay.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
choice_data_list: You have to confront that feeling.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: …I see. Not doing so would be running away.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Very well. I will face this frustration now so that I may prevent it from befalling me again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, Grass Wonder and I evaluate everything that went wrong in today's race.
